item.title: Guntas Sandhu Finishes T-20th as Ananyaa Sood Is T-42 In WAAP Golf
item.description: The Amundi Evian Championship: Guntas Sandhu braved the gusting wind and carded 5-over 77 on a day when scoring was very difficult at the Women’s Amateur Asia-Pacific (WAAP).

item.title: 'They Should Move Beyond Making Statements And Focus On Cricket': Kaneria Slams Pakistan's Below-par Show Vs India
item.description: T20 World Cup: Former spinner Danish Kaneria launched a scathing critique of Pakistan following their below-par performance against India in the T20 World Cup match, saying the result exposed the side’s struggles while chasing targets and suggested that the players focus more on their cricket than on off-field statements.

item.title: India Fall 2-4 to Argentina in Rourkela Leg of FIH Men’s Pro League 2025–26
item.description: India suffered a 2-4 defeat to Argentina in the FIH Men’s Pro League 2025–26 match at Birsa Munda Hockey Stadium, Rourkela, despite late goals from Aditya Lalage and Sanjay.

item.title: T20 WC: Farooqi Out As Afghanistan Elect To Bowl First Against UAE In A Must-win Clash
item.description: United Arab Emirates: Afghanistan captain Rashid Khan has elected to field first after winning the toss against United Arab Emirates in their crucial Group D game of the 2026 Men’s T20 World Cup at the Arun Jaitley Stadium on Monday.

item.title: Bengaluru FC Begin ISL 2025-26 Campaign with Dominant 2-0 Win Over Sporting Club Delhi
item.description: Former champions Bengaluru FC kicked off their Indian Super League 2025-26 season with a 2-0 victory over Sporting Club Delhi, thanks to goals from N Sivasakthi and Sunil Chhetri at the Sree Kanteerava Stadium.

item.title: When Handshakes Stop: Cricket’s Most Controversial No-Handshake Moments
item.description: From Asia Cup 2025 to IPL 2023, cricket has seen several high-profile no-handshake incidents. Explore the most controversial moments in cricket history where players refused handshakes as a form of protest or defiance.

item.title: Cerundolo Wins Argentina Open Title, His First ATP Tour Crown Since 2024
item.description: Buenos Aires Lawn Tennis Club: Top seed and local favorite Francisco Cerundolo secured his fourth ATP title with a 6-4, 6-2 win over Italy's Luciano Darderi in the Argentina Open final.

item.title: T20 WC: Alex Volschenk Approved As Replacement For Ben Shikongo In Namibia's Squad
item.description: The ICC Event Technical Committee: Namibia have drafted seam-bowling all-rounder Alex Volschenk into their squad for the 2026 ICC Men’s T20 World Cup after fast bowler Ben Shikongo was ruled out with a thigh injury, the International Cricket Council (ICC) said on Monday.

item.title: Shelton Saves 3 Championship Points Against Fritz To Clinch Title In Dallas
item.description: Infosys ATP Win: Ben Shelton saved three championship points to defeat Taylor Fritz in Dallas Open final and capture his first title of the season and fourth ATP Tour title.

item.title: T20 WC: 'He's Just Got To Give Himself A Little More Time', Shastri's Key Advice To Abhishek After Two Ducks
item.description: T20 World Cup: Former India cricketer and coach Ravi Shastri has urged Abhishek Sharma to be a little bit more patient early in his innings during the remainder of the ICC Men's T20 World Cup after the opener suffered his second consecutive failure with the bat when he was dismissed for a duck in India's emphatic victory over arch-rival Pakistan.
